DATA for gate.dateuniqueness: the families, each family's homed modules (never judged for their own family), the sanctioned private copies (function-level, each with its reason; a sanction whose function stops matching its family shape is a stale-exception failure), and the out-of-scope file classes. Extend the map here, never in the scanner's code. Homes are per cluster because the tree's import rules forbid one literal module for every surface (attention's import isolation; the venue's standalone by-path loads; the workrecord lib's standalone root) — the invariant is one owner per intent per cluster, with the map naming every owner.
